steps.content: [Apply multiple filter layers to this scene at the beginning]
The darkness slowly recedes, revealing Hypatia standing alone among ruins once more.
No one is left beside her. Even if she were to ask, "What should I do?" there is no one left to answer.
You must find the answer yourself, Hypatia. In this contaminated place, there is only one mystery that calls to the scholar in her, only one question that demands to be solved:
Why do the remnant wills drifting through this tear zone... still move forward?

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: What?! You're saying there are no Hypercubes in those ruins? Impossible!! I've bet everything on this!

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: DisCity failed to find Hypercubes at the main crash site. Now they look to its birthplace, Furor. They intend to steal our hope!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Yes... that must be why Ms. Margaret brought people here...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: According to the observation reports... the data is thorough, internally consistent. There's no room for fabrication... The reaction concentration in the Furor ruins truly isn't enough to form Hypercubes. DisCity, too...
The concentration is extremely low. This is a remarkably weak Black Ring, insufficient to form a mining deposit.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... it isn't weak...

steps.speaker: Furorian Boy
steps.content: Lady Hypatia... why did you not tell us the truth? Why did you leave us behind?
The images that have haunted countless nights return, flickering before her eyes once more. She stares, wide-eyed, and lets the nightmare unfold frame by frame.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I witnessed it myself... so many people, such intense emotion... they completely overwhelmed every Aurum Secretum barrier across Furor...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Average M-value 170... no, at least 480. Density... you'd need hundreds of Apostles to cause that level of destruction...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mania that concentrated... wouldn't just vanish...
She pushes her weakened body up and slowly straightens her spine.

Without the insight to unravel plots or the courage to face powerful foes, a person who is both incapable and fearful... if she still dares to call herself a scholar, then this is her final, fragile claim to that title.

[Confidential Report of DisCity Scholars]

...The contamination originating from a Black Ring's birthplace does not dissipate upon the Black Ring's destruction. Significant purification efforts will still be necessary.

[Confidential Report of DisCity Scholars]

It has been verified that BR-005 has been in a state of continuous migration since its inception, from Furor to DisCity. This movement has produced extensive contamination along its path.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: If both its origin point and its impact site show only this level of contamination, then...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: A far greater amount of Black Ring residue must have been transported somewhere else... along its path of migration...

Countless words of accusation roar toward her again, sharp and piercing. This time, Hypatia neither flinches nor weeps. She lets them strike her, and she pushes forward through the numbed detachment...
And in doing so, she finally hears what lies beyond them.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: All this ******* contamination was brought by you!! This <color=#fb9259>tear zone</color> stands as proof of your crimes!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Its concentration would have to be high enough to disrupt catastrophes, attract Apostles, and further condense the contamination...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This body has a... peculiar resonance with the Black Ring. It reacts unpredictably in environments with strong <color=#fb9259>Black Ring effects</color>.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Its properties would need to be uniform, capable under specific conditions of simulating effects nearly identical to the Black Ring itself...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The theory must be correct. At its core, there has to be...

Ahead lies an endless darkness. No light, no shadow, no path beneath her feet. Each step she takes feels unsteady, uncertain. This darkness is a distillation of every day and night she's spent lost in confusion and fear. Every instinct in her body screams for retreat, for escape, in a desperate, primal plea. And then—
Before she reaches the deepest dark, her silent plea is answered. A final vision unfolds before her eyes:
A shimmering golden light. The guidance her soul has always sought.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: No matter what happens, I will always be by your side, guiding your way.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You couldn't guide my way... no one else can...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'll find it myself...
Hypatia drags her body forward. Her steps no longer obey her will, carrying her slowly through what is both the first illusion and the last.
Reality is bitterly cold, and she has returned to it. Ahead, shadowy phantoms drift—faceless, silent, their gaze fixed on her.
She no longer resists. No longer fears. She simply walks, mechanically, toward the heart of the dark.
And as she passes through the cold spirits, she begins to hear their whispers.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Ta-da! Let me present to you the finest settlement in all of WhiteSands, City of Rifts, Furor! Welcome home, Lady Hypatia!
A cold that pierces the bone, a contamination that clings like tar—they climb her body together, slowly devouring the last fragments of her spirit.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Lady Hypatia, you're back!

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Ah, Ms. Campbell of Fraser! I knew you would come back to see us.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
steps.content: Thanks to the Aurum Secretum devices, all the homes damaged by catastrophes have been repaired. Everyone's moved back in, safe and sound.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Woman
steps.content: And thanks to you, the marketplace is open again. Every household has brought their crafts, their specialties. Look, isn't it livelier than before? We even have goods from other towns now!

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
steps.content: Soon, it will not be just Furor. Once Aurum Secretum technology spreads across the farlands, everyone will have a safe place to live. Markets will stay open, day after day!

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Wow, then I want to go see other places too! Help them build homes that are strong and beautiful! Then wherever Lady Hypatia goes, she'll see smiling faces... and taste delicious food everywhere!
Even in the deepest dark and coldest silence, people welcome her with cheers and smiling faces. And she remembers every one of them.
It feels like the old times again, as though she's back in Furor. But...
They are already dead.
The thought alone strains her composure. She should be on the ground. She should be running away.
Yet her earlier promise still stands. She didn't come here to flee.
She must keep moving.

The spirits press close, drawing strange gifts from within their flickering forms. They pass them through countless spectral hands until the offerings reach her. Their voices weave a gentle, insistent enchantment, urging her to stay... to feel how much they care.
Welcome home.
Welcome home, Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm sorry.
She reaches out and accepts every gift, holding them close to her chest.
The inky contamination begins to corrode her hands and arms, seeping slowly toward her heart.
From this day forward, as a child of Fraser, will you dedicate yourself wholly to this city and lead its people toward prosperity?
Yes, I swear.
No matter the hardship, whatever the cost, will you never abandon your duty or betray your oath?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Yes... I swear.
Contamination seeps into her arms and chest, the brand at her nape burning. Images flash across her mind.
But she no longer cares. She no longer fears any of it.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I know... They're all just illusions. All of this... it's only contamination...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But what others may dismiss as meaningless, I cannot simply turn away from.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... cannot let them go. And I will not...
If stubbornness is the chosen path, then be stubborn to the end, and carry all the hatred, curses, grief, and regret that come with it.
Remain sober to the pain that goes bone-deep; in hell, numbness is the true damnation.
Embracing the agony she cannot leave behind, Hypatia turns from the path out of the catastrophe tear. Instead, she ventures deeper into the heart of the wound.
From high above, two ant-like figures inch their way across the endless sea of white sand.
They move along the edge of the tear zone, tracing its border like a long, deliberate ribbon, stumbling again and again—yet always rising, always pressing forward.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: ...Is your body really enhanced by Aurum Secretum?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: I'm no match for you, obviously... I know. I'll go look for her.
Saina steals a nervous glance at Helga, then quickly volunteers everything she's learned.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: The detector's signal matches the direction the DisCity spy fled. There's no doubt.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: DisCity spy? What DisCity spy? You watch your tongue. You've seen it yourself the whole way. That girl is dedicated to Furor. She is no spy.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: ...Yes.

The two of them scour the edge of the catastrophe tear, searching each location thoroughly, but find only vague traces. Even at their closest approach, they can't tell if the distant figure is an Apostle's illusion or a living person.
Time spent here lowers the odds of survival with every minute. Desperate, Helga cups her hands to her mouth and shouts into the depths of the tear.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Hypatia—!
Hypatia—!
For a moment, the distant figure hesitates as if hearing something. She turns, gaze drifting dazedly over her shoulder.
But she sees nothing. Perhaps she only imagined the sound. The girl turns away, swallowed completely by the dark.
